Policies and Initiatives.title: Union Budget 2026: Mountain, turtle, birdwatching trails to come up in Himachal, Jammu & Kashmir, Odisha, Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Union Budget 2026 will fund the development of mountain, turtle, and birdwatching trails in several Indian states, including Himachal, Jammu & Kashmir, Odisha, Karnataka, Kerala, and Tamil Nadu. A birdwatching trail will be specifically developed along the Pulicat Lake on the Andhra Pradesh-Tamil Nadu border. These projects aim to promote eco-tourism in these regions.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Reform-heavy Budget draws Himachal industry nod
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The 2026 Union Budget focuses on simplifying processes and improving ease of doing business, prioritizing a trust-based economy. It includes initiatives such as "Biopharma Shakti" and support for MSMEs to drive long-term industrial growth and self-reliance. The budget also promotes Ayurveda sector growth and infrastructure development, with reduced drug import duties.
